MOONLIGHT MUNCH RUN

Kindness snacks: 0
PAUSED · PRESS ▶

Feed the moonlit road

Left thumb: slide up/down to steer. Right thumb: tap or hold to toss snacks straight ahead. Both thumbs work together.

Mouse: move anywhere over the road to steer vertically; any click tosses from your truck’s current lane. Keyboard: W/S or ↑/↓ to steer, Space/F to toss, Escape to pause.

Hungry guests cheer and drift away when fed. Bumps just wobble—no health, game-over, or endings. Feed 8, 25 and 60 guests for three keepsakes saved only in this separate experiment.

The family truck echoes Mabuhay!; these friendly guests and the feeding journey are original inventions, not book canon or claims about folklore beings.

Guide · toss · keep the night kind. Landscape gives you a wider road.
